sql: SELECT split_part(e.market_ticker,'-',2) AS contest, count(*) AS rungs, round(sum(coalesce(p.pnl,0))::numeric,2) AS twin_pnl FROM live_paper_parity_events e LEFT JOIN paper_positions p ON p.market_ticker=e.market_ticker AND p.strategy=e.twin_tag WHERE e.twin_tag='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND e.twin_outcome='opened' AND e.parent_outcome='skip_live_tier' AND e.series IN ('KXNCAAFSPREAD','KXNCAAFTOTAL','KXNCAAFGAME') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY twin_pnl DESC
